messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD P1 - inference-service.latency.p95 > 1500ms (count=12). Trigger: canary-checker. https://pd.example/incidents/PD123456 — paging primary oncall

pagerduty: Incident PD123456 created and routed to #eng-oncall. Escalation timer set (5m).

alex.g: acked — looking into it now. pulling metrics.

sam: ack. any customer-facing errors or just slow responses?

alex.g: so far just latency; error-rate is normal. looks concentrated on us-west-2 dedicated pool. KV-cache miss rate jumped. snippet from logs:```
2026-03-15T12:34:55Z inference-router us-west-2 p95=1620ms kv_miss=0.72 batch_size=8
2026-03-15T12:35:10Z inference-router us-west-2 p95=1705ms kv_miss=0.81 batch_size=12
```

maria: @alex.g i deployed a small routing canary ~3m ago (router-config -> canary v42). could be directing traffic to a slightly mis-sized instance pool. rolling back now if you want.

lee: if it's KV warmup that could be noisy and transient. options: 1) mute alert temporarily, 2) route canary traffic to fallback variant, 3) scale pool.

alex.g: gonna try fallback route first to avoid customer impact. applying quick route override:```
rdctl routing set-policy --service inference --policy fallback-small-quant --scope canary --duration 10m
```

alex.g: applied. will watch p95.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty update: PD123456 ACK by alex.g. Next escalation in 5m unless auto-resolved.

sam: nice. if p95 improves we can keep muted while we investigate root cause. set a short postmortem if it flaps.

maria: rollback started: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-router --to-revision=41` — CI shows rollback succeeded.

alex.g: p95 trending down already:
```
12:36 p95=980ms kv_miss=0.33 batch_size=6
12:37 p95=720ms kv_miss=0.18 batch_size=5
```

oncall-bot: Alert auto-resolved: inference-service.latency.p95 back below threshold. PD123456 marked RESOLVED by system.

lee: auto-resolve — sounds like classic canary-induced warmup spike. low customer impact but noisy.

sam: agree. follow-up: mute canary alerts for next 24h and add KV-warmup smoothing to the canary rollout guide.

maria: opening a tiny postmortem PR and a follow-up ticket to add smoothing flags to rollout pipeline. assigning to eng-runtime.

alex.g: adding note in incident ticket: "transient canary routing -> KV warmup -> p95 spike -> rollback -> auto-resolve". tagging @eng-runtime for follow-up. :white_check_mark:

lee: cool. if it reoccurs we escalate to Dedicated infra owners. for now closing thread. :eyes:
